newsitem.title: MEXICO: Unit of Mexico's Sanluis Corp wins GM contracts.
newsitem.headline: Unit of Mexico's Sanluis Corp wins GM contracts.

text.p: Mexican mining firm Sanluis Corporacion said on Sunday that its subsidiary Rassini Autopartes had won two contracts to provide piers for General Motors platforms for light trucks.
The deliveries for GM's C/K platform, the base for its Sierra, Crew Cab, Chevy Blazer, Yukon Tahoe and Suburban models, will start in the fourth quarter of this year, Sanluis said in a news release.
The C/K platform gradually will be replaced by the GMT - 800 platform, Sanluis said. Rassini Autopartes will start supplying that platform in the third quarter of 1998.
Sanluis said it expects to receive $65 million for the two sales and would expand its plant in Piedras Negras near the Texas border in order to produce the platforms.
